rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (10 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Live_at_Third_Man_Records_(Billie_Eilish_album), https://www.discogs.com/release/14493214-Billie-Eilish-Live-At-Third-Man-Records.
